name: a large grey dog sitting in the doorway
description: A grey dog the size of a bench sits square in the way, front legs braced, watching you with its head slightly tipped, in no hurry at all.
looks: It has the patient, faintly disappointed face of an animal that has waited for people who did not come back.
Its tail moves once against the floor and thinks better of it.
It is sitting on something. You will not find out what.
says: I will move. I always move.
You smell like outside. I am not complaining.
emotes: {it} shakes itself from nose to tail and sits back down exactly as it was.
{it} follows something across the room with its eyes that is not there any more.
{it} rests its chin on the floor and sighs through its nose.
